components.name: success_bonus
components.description: Large positive reward for a successful landing: both legs contact, |x| < 0.1, |vx| < 0.1, |vy| < 0.1, |angle| < 0.1 radians.

components.name: distance_progress
components.description: Progress-delta reward for horizontal distance from pad: positive when moving closer, negative when moving away.

components.name: vertical_speed_progress
components.description: Progress-delta reward for vertical speed: positive when slowing down, negative when speeding up.

components.name: angle_penalty
components.description: Small negative reward proportional to absolute angle to encourage upright orientation.

components.name: fuel_penalty_main
components.description: Small negative reward for using main engine to encourage fuel efficiency.

components.name: fuel_penalty_side
components.description: Small negative reward for using side engines to encourage fuel efficiency.

components.name: altitude_penalty
components.description: Small negative reward per step when altitude y > 0.5 to discourage hovering at high altitude.

components.name: descent_bonus
components.description: One-shot event-gated bonus for first descending below y < 0.3 (near ground).

components.name: near_ground_stability_bonus
components.description: One-shot event-gated bonus for first achieving a stable state near the ground (y < 0.3, low velocities, upright).

components.name: progress_bonus
components.description: One-shot event-gated bonus for achieving a stable near-pad state with both legs contacting.

components.name: action_0_bonus
components.description: One-shot event-gated bonus for using action 0 when the lander first achieves a stable near-pad state with both legs contacting.

components.name: crash_penalty
components.description: Large negative reward for crashing (terminated without success).

total_reward_formula: success_bonus + distance_progress + vertical_speed_progress + angle_penalty + fuel_penalty_main + fuel_penalty_side + altitude_penalty + descent_bonus + near_ground_stability_bonus + progress_bonus + action_0_bonus + crash_penalty
